Description: Scenario with updating information that requires a response. (Some PGMT simulations might actually be regular scenarios, not simulations.)
Behaviors: Interact,Decide / Select,Think Critically (Prospective),Implement
AI-resistance affordance: Dynamic inputs, decision traces, and debriefs require situated judgment and adaptation rather than a static generated response.
Recommended scoring evidence: Decision log, response at each update, rationale for adaptation, outcome interpretation, debrief reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Business, health professions, public policy, hospitality, cybersecurity, environmental science, agriculture, emergency management.

Description: Contextual information is described, and the examinee is asked to respond either by analyzing & explaining parts of the scenario, making a decision, or designing a solution. Can use many formats (narrative, video, artifacts).
Behaviors: Think Critically (Retrospective)
AI-resistance affordance: Case-specific variables, localized details, and required rationale make generic answers weak; variations can be rotated across learners.
Recommended scoring evidence: Issue identification, evidence use, reasoning chain, decision criteria, transfer to a changed condition.
Discipline Affinity: All disciplines; especially professional programs, social sciences, humanities, health, business, education.

Description: A mock interaction between the learner and other(s), usually used to demonstrate specific communication skills (such as responsiveness, confict management, giving feedback, etc.)
Behaviors: React
AI-resistance affordance: Live or recorded interpersonal performance, follow-up prompts, and observation of behavior resist text-only outsourcing.
Recommended scoring evidence: Communication checklist, interaction rubric, response to cues, professionalism, client/peer feedback, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Counseling, social work, psychology, communication, health, hospitality, management, education, legal studies.

Description: Demonstration in or observation from a real world context. Focus on active tasks or interactions (such as teaching, interpersonal interactions, using tools or equipment).
Behaviors: Interact,React,Implement,Create,Know / Understand,Explain,Think Critically (Prospective),Decide / Select
AI-resistance affordance: Authentic performance evidence, supervisor/observer notes, and contextual constraints directly show what the learner can do.
Recommended scoring evidence: Observation checklist, work sample, standards alignment, supervisor/peer feedback, safety/quality criteria, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Health, education, exercise science, agriculture, environmental science, labs, engineering, arts, trades.

Description: Not directly observed/assessed. Learner must provide evidence, documentation, and/or other reflection.
Behaviors: Think Critically (Prospective),Think Critically (Retrospective),Show Evidence,Create,Know / Understand,Explain,Decide / Select
AI-resistance affordance: Local context, stakeholder feedback, milestones, and implementation evidence make a single generic product insufficient.
Recommended scoring evidence: Project plan, artifact/deliverable, stakeholder feedback, implementation evidence, process log, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Capstones; business, IT/cybersecurity, public health, policy, environmental science, agriculture, education, community-engaged courses.

Description: Similar to a real world project, but not intended for real / immediate application in the real world. May use a hypothetical or real context, but no real implementation or usage of findings is expected.
Behaviors: Think Critically (Prospective),Create,Know / Understand,Explain,Decide / Select
AI-resistance affordance: Design constraints, prototype iterations, critique response, and rationale reveal learner decisions across time.
Recommended scoring evidence: Design rationale, prototype/artifact, iteration evidence, feasibility/testing evidence, critique response.
Discipline Affinity: Engineering, arts/design, architecture, media, technology, business, education, environmental design.

Description: Structured live or recorded questioning that probes reasoning, assumptions, and transfer.
Behaviors: Argue / Defend; Explain; Think Critically; Model / Represent; Self-Regulate / Revise
Format / Modality: Audio/Spoken, Video, In-person observation, Virtual observation
AI-resistance affordance: Follow-up questions verify authorship and reasoning.
Recommended scoring evidence: Rubric for accuracy, reasoning, evidence use, and responsiveness.
Discipline Affinity: All; especially math, humanities, professional programs

Description: Learner performs a procedure or technique under observed or recorded conditions.
Behaviors: Perform Procedure / Technique; Implement; Show Evidence
Format / Modality: Observation, Video, In-person observation, Virtual observation
AI-resistance affordance: Direct performance evidence cannot be fully outsourced to text generation.
Recommended scoring evidence: Checklist/rubric, error analysis, safety/procedure criteria.
Discipline Affinity: Health, labs, engineering, arts, trades

Description: Timed stations with standardized patients/clients, scenarios, and scoring criteria.
Behaviors: React; Interact; Ethical / Professional Judgment; Perform Procedure / Technique; Diagnose / Troubleshoot
AI-resistance affordance: Simulated human interaction and station-specific facts require situated performance.
Recommended scoring evidence: Station checklist, global rating, client feedback, rater notes.
Discipline Affinity: Health professions, social work, counseling, education

Description: Learner formulates a question, designs a method, gathers evidence, and interprets findings.
Behaviors: Investigate / Inquire; Think Critically; Show Evidence; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Requires original evidence collection and decisions about method.
Recommended scoring evidence: Research log, method rationale, evidence quality, interpretation.
Discipline Affinity: Sciences, social sciences, humanities

Description: Learner plans, conducts, analyzes, and explains lab work or a practical investigation.
Behaviors: Perform Procedure / Technique; Investigate / Inquire; Think Critically; Explain
Format / Modality: In-person observation, Video, Artifacts, Discipline-specific format
AI-resistance affordance: Combines process, equipment, and data evidence.
Recommended scoring evidence: Lab notebook, observation checklist, data quality, explanation.
Discipline Affinity: Natural sciences, health, engineering

Description: Learner creates a mathematical, conceptual, computational, or visual representation and explains assumptions.
Behaviors: Model / Represent; Think Critically; Create; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Assumption defense and scenario-specific constraints make generic answers weak.
Recommended scoring evidence: Model accuracy, assumptions, limitations, sensitivity, explanation.
Discipline Affinity: Math, statistics, economics, engineering, science

Description: Learner interprets a case, chooses among options, and justifies a recommendation.
Behaviors: Decide / Select; Think Critically; Ethical / Professional Judgment; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Case variables can be randomized or local; rationale matters more than prose.
Recommended scoring evidence: Decision criteria, use of evidence, tradeoff analysis, consequences.
Discipline Affinity: Business, health, policy, education, social sciences

Description: Learner defends a position, addresses counterarguments, and uses evidence under questioning.
Behaviors: Argue / Defend; Interact; Explain; Think Critically
Format / Modality: Audio/Spoken, Video, In-person observation, Virtual observation
AI-resistance affordance: Live rebuttal and assigned evidence constrain outsourcing.
Recommended scoring evidence: Argument quality, evidence use, rebuttal, responsiveness.
Discipline Affinity: Law, humanities, social sciences, policy, ethics

Description: Learner applies criteria to exemplars or peer work and explains judgments.
Behaviors: Critique / Calibrate; Self-Regulate / Revise; Interact; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Requires comparison, judgment, and often interaction with peer artifacts.
Recommended scoring evidence: Accuracy/calibration, criteria use, feedback quality.
Discipline Affinity: Writing, design, professional programs, all project courses

Description: Learner submits final work plus drafts, feedback, decisions, revisions, and reflective commentary.
Behaviors: Self-Regulate / Revise; Show Evidence; Create; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Process trail and iteration history make single-shot AI products insufficient.
Recommended scoring evidence: Draft history, feedback use, reflection, final quality.
Discipline Affinity: All; especially writing, design, education, capstones

Description: Extended authentic project for a client, community, workplace, or complex real-world problem.
Behaviors: Create; Implement; Collaborate / Coordinate; Communicate for Audience; Think Critically
Format / Modality: Artifacts, Written, Video, Presentation, Discipline-specific format
AI-resistance affordance: Authentic constraints, stakeholder feedback, and milestones are hard to outsource completely.
Recommended scoring evidence: Proposal, prototype, client feedback, final presentation, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Engineering, business, public health, design, IT, education

Description: Learner presents design work for critique, explains choices, receives/uses feedback, and revises.
Behaviors: Create; Critique / Calibrate; Self-Regulate / Revise; Communicate for Audience
AI-resistance affordance: Visible design artifacts, critique dialogue, and revision history support authenticity.
Recommended scoring evidence: Design criteria, rationale, critique response, iteration.
Discipline Affinity: Design, architecture, arts, media, engineering

Description: Learner analyzes a provided or learner-generated data set and communicates interpretation and limitations.
Behaviors: Think Critically; Model / Represent; Explain; Use Tools / AI Responsibly
AI-resistance affordance: Unique/local data and code/output logs provide evidence beyond final narrative.
Recommended scoring evidence: Analysis plan, reproducibility, visualization, interpretation, limitations.
Discipline Affinity: Statistics, data science, social science, business, public health

Description: Learner demonstrates code, explains design/debugging choices, and responds to questions.
Behaviors: Troubleshoot / Diagnose; Implement; Explain; Use Tools / AI Responsibly
Format / Modality: Video, Virtual observation, In-person observation, Artifacts
AI-resistance affordance: Live explanation and debugging verifies understanding of submitted code.
Recommended scoring evidence: Correctness, maintainability, tests, explanation, debugging.
Discipline Affinity: Computer science, information systems, data science

Description: Learner makes repeated decisions in a dynamic, rule-based environment and explains strategy/results.
Behaviors: Decide / Select; React; Think Critically; Collaborate / Coordinate
AI-resistance affordance: Dynamic information and decision traces produce process evidence.
Recommended scoring evidence: Decision log, strategy rationale, outcomes analysis, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Business, management, economics, policy, health

Description: Learner documents and reflects on supervised work in authentic settings.
Behaviors: Show Evidence; Implement; React; Ethical / Professional Judgment; Communicate for Audience
AI-resistance affordance: Authentic context and supervisor observations provide external evidence.
Recommended scoring evidence: Work samples, supervisor checklist, reflection, standards alignment.
Discipline Affinity: Education, health, social work, public service

Description: Learner addresses a community or stakeholder need and documents outcomes and learning.
Behaviors: Create; Implement; Communicate for Audience; Ethical / Professional Judgment
AI-resistance affordance: Local context and stakeholder interaction constrain AI-generated generic products.
Recommended scoring evidence: Needs assessment, deliverable, stakeholder feedback, reflection.
Discipline Affinity: Public health, policy, education, social sciences, business

Description: Learner analyzes source sets using sourcing, contextualization, corroboration, and evidence-based interpretation.
Behaviors: Investigate / Inquire; Argue / Defend; Think Critically; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Assigned/local source packets and evidence matrices limit generic response quality.
Recommended scoring evidence: Source evaluation, corroboration, claim-evidence fit, contextualization.
Discipline Affinity: History, humanities, media literacy, social sciences

Description: Learner synthesizes evidence for a defined audience and presents actionable recommendations.
Behaviors: Communicate for Audience; Decide / Select; Argue / Defend; Ethical / Professional Judgment
AI-resistance affordance: Audience, constraints, and questions require situated judgment.
Recommended scoring evidence: Brief quality, evidence synthesis, feasibility, audience fit.
Discipline Affinity: Policy, public health, business, education, social sciences

Description: Learner evaluates the accuracy, bias, provenance, and usefulness of AI/tool output or online sources.
Behaviors: Use Tools / AI Responsibly; Critique / Calibrate; Think Critically; Explain
AI-resistance affordance: Shifts AI from hidden author to object of assessment.
Recommended scoring evidence: Verification trail, source quality, correction rationale, disclosure.
Discipline Affinity: All disciplines using AI/search; media literacy
